_doc: Policy cases the current backend is KNOWN to fail, each tied to the roadmap step that fixes it. pytest runs them as strict xfail: when a step lands and a case starts passing, the test goes red until its entry is deleted here. Steps: 3 = trigger taxonomy (D1/D4), 4 = autonomy profiles (D2/D3).

POL-07-competitor-is-context.reason: Competitor mention opens a handoff and, with a rep online, ALERT holds the conversation. It should be context while the agent continues.

POL-08-stakeholder-is-context.reason: Stakeholder involvement holds the conversation with a rep online. It is context, not an intervention.

POL-09-buying-before-fit-online.reason: A buying signal before fit is confirmed holds the conversation and announces a handoff. It should notify the rep and keep running the fit check.

POL-11-pricing-interest.reason: Any mention of price/cost/budget holds the conversation with a rep online. Pricing interest is attention; only negotiation is an intervention.

POL-12-pricing-negotiation.reason: No pricing-negotiation trigger exists; a discount demand with the rep offline is answered autonomously.

POL-20-restricted-after-human-request.reason: After a human request the agent only repeats a holding message; no restricted-autonomy profile exists.

POL-21-approval-gate-offline-not-unrestr.reason: With the approval gate on and the rep offline the mode machine returns AUTONOMOUS and the agent answers unrestricted.

POL-26-hold-followups-not-verbatim-repea.reason: Follow-ups during an open intervention repeat the same holding text verbatim.
